title: Mao's birthplace in Shaoshan, a center of 'red tourism': 'It's an enriching experience for my education'
subhead: 'Mao's Fraught Legacy' (6/7). Mao Zedong's birthplace swiftly became a site of memory. Each year, 12 million Chinese people, from schoolchildren to retirees, travel there to pay their respects, learn the history of the Communist Party, or simply for entertainment.

title: Mary Austin, the quiet custodian of Freddie Mercury's legacy
subhead: She was the partner, personal assistant and heir to Queen's flamboyant frontman. In her first book, 75-year-old Mary Austin unveils previously unseen Freddie Mercury archives. He called her the love of his life until his death.

title: A$AP Rocky, the rapper reinventing masculinity
subhead: Like many of his peers, the global superstar grew up amid poverty and violence. Yet he stands apart in the world of rap. He rejects homophobia and misogyny, embraces being 'Mr. Rihanna' and is open about caring for his children. A Chanel ambassador, he is both an heir to the tradition of Black dandyism and the embodiment of a modern masculinity less bound by traditional norms.
